question: Bank of America's 2025 Form 10-K re-presents its 2025 quarters in Table 7 (Selected Quarterly Financial Data). supporting_facts.label: Income tax expense
supporting_facts.period: third quarter 2025 (Table 7, 2025 Quarters: Fourth, Third, Second, First)

supporting_facts.label: Effective in the fourth quarter of 2025, the Corporation elected to change accounting
supporting_facts.printed: solar renewable energy equity investments, which were applied on a retrospective

derivation: 2,076 - 987 = 1,089 ($ millions); the 10-K figure is the higher one.
notes: Other third-quarter 2025 lines moved too: noninterest income 13,807 vs 12,855 (+952), income before income taxes 10,408 vs 9,456 (+952), net income 8,332 vs 8,469 (-137). The 10-Q's 2,279 is the nine-month figure, not the quarter. Because of the retrospective change, full-year 2025 less the 10-Q nine months does not equal the 10-K's own fourth quarter.
